## TemplateEngine.compileBlockGCallbackAnswer() method

Compiles callback-answer blocks from a template into executable functions.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static compileBlockGCallbackAnswer(template: string, baseBlocks?: ReturnType<typeof TemplateEngine._processGBaseBlocks>): {
        [AGBaseId: string]: {
            [ALang: string]: (data?: ITemplateData) => string;
        };
    };
```

**Returns:**

{ \[AGBaseId: string\]: { \[ALang: string\]: (data?: ITemplateData) =&gt; string; }; }

Compiled callback-answer functions organized by base ID and language

## Remarks

This method parses `<g-callback-answer>` blocks from the template and compiles them into functions that generate rendered toast text. The result is organized by base ID and language. Each content string runs the same pipeline as `<g-message>` (script → map → switch → scope-exec → scope-variables → function).

Output shape: - First level key: `AGBaseId` (from `<g-base id="...">`<!-- -->, or `"default"` if omitted) - Second level key: `ALang` (from `lang="..."`<!-- -->, or `"default"` if omitted) - Value: `(data?: Record<string, unknown>) => string`

## Example


```typescript
const compiled = TemplateEngine.compileBlockGCallbackAnswer(`<g-base><g-callback-answer>Hi {{name}}</g-callback-answer></g-base>`);
const text = compiled.default?.default?.({name: `Ani`});
// Result: 'Hi Ani'
```
